verdict: PASS FOR NOMINAL MODELED FIT; FIELD VERIFICATION REQUIRED
scope: Fresh His-office redesign, frozen canonical layout. Independent read-only geometry, operation, material/export and browser camera/keyboard checks, plus separate nonmetric visual concept and document reviews.
limits: Generalized scan room outline has 5–12 cm uncertainty; fine fixture forms are review proxies, doors observed closed and swings inferred.
50 cm route uses a hypothetical person circle and nominal boxes/caster circles; it is tight and not a real site, accessibility or ergonomics guarantee.
Cat-tree basket/branch offsets and lamp U-base separate dimensions are unpublished/photo-derived; measure the owned pieces and reposition/rotate if needed.
Cat upper basket model is only ~2 cm off rear wall; dresser door-box gap ~3 cm and closet-approach desk gap 5 cm are smaller than scan uncertainty.
Closet interior and hanging garment hems are unrecorded; three shoe racks remain a conditional storage idea.
Dresser fully open drawer leaves ~79 cm to main caster working pose but ~34 cm at full chair pullback; tuck chair before sustained drawer access.
Thin rug-pad contacts are soft support; compression not simulated.
Desk tests check external upper-assembly clearance, not mechanical telescope internals, cables, actuators, load or stability.
Triangle surface intersection method does not rule out every fully contained solid, and sampled swept-box candidates do not mathematically prove all intermediate heights.
STORKLINTA Anchor/Unlock wall fixing is not modeled/verified; dresser rear is about 8.7 cm forward of corrected brick plane. Verify approved attachment/spacer or adjust on site.

Generated concepts preserve visual topology and facing, but do not validate metric dimensions; fine silhouettes, materials and lighting are representative. View B retains one cosmetic secondary-tabletop spot/grommet absent from the modeled IKEA top.

At one exact triangulation-edge LED probe the accelerated viewer BVH misses while native THREE raycasting returns two hits. Both offset LED positive controls, nine empty aperture rays and both rim controls pass; the exported bar is valid. This is documented numerical ray precision, not a product geometry gap.
